svg.title: Prime sum versus the sum over zeros
svg.desc: Computed: normalized G(y) from primes (amber) and the explicit formula with the first 100 zeta zeros (indigo), 100 <= y <= 2e6; dashed: the term a hypothetical zero at 0.62+40i would add (it grows like y^0.12).
